itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.title: Willa Cather: A Literary Life | Willa Cather Archive
itemsInTheOrderOfEachAnswer.snippet: This is an essay praising dogs and denigrating cats and seems to have been part of a debate judged by her grandfather. The misspellings are Cather's: "The dog is a very intelligent animal . . . . The nature of most dogs is kind, noble and generous. O!

itemsInNoOrder.title: The 37 Best Gifts for Tweens of 2025 | Reviews by Wirecutter
itemsInNoOrder.snippet:
Pet-friendly socks
PetParty
These goofy socks never get old: They can be personalized with the face of your tween’s favorite pet or person.
PetParty’s Customized Socks are undoubtedly silly. They’re also fun, adorable, and irresistible — especially for the tween who loves animals.

itemsInNoOrder.title: The Best Cat Beds (According to Our Cats) for 2025 | Reviews by Wirecutter
itemsInNoOrder.snippet:
For cats who prefer to nap in enclosed beds and cave-like spaces, the Meowfia Premium Cat Cave is an excellent and relatively affordable option.
It’s a nice-looking cave for cats who like to burrow. Some cats just want a dark cave to chill out in.

itemsInNoOrder.title: The Waves
itemsInNoOrder.snippet: She was not crying, but her eyes, which are so beautiful, were narrow as cats' eyes before they spring. I shall follow her, Neville. I shall go gently behind her, to be at hand, with my curiosity, to comfort her when she bursts out in a rage and thinks, "I am alone."
